pages.text: Crafting together a Memory Core with a few Campfires and some Blaze Powder results in a fiery wisp often called 'Born To Burn'. It is similar to an artificial being like a Vex, but it is far more basic in its capabilities. All it does is burn endlessly, set on fire any person holding it, and place fire when used while crouching.

It is best used alongside effects that require to be on fire, such as the $(l:execrations/pyromaniac)$(c)$(o)Pyromania$() and $(l:execrations/eruption)$(c)$(o)Eruption$() Execrations. It is also quite effective at clearing out Powdered Snow if walked into while holding it.
